card.name: Kidney function formula symbols and numbers
card.fires_on: Equals signs, brackets, digits and decimal points inside written kidney-function equations such as the Schwartz or Cockcroft-Gault formulas, just before a multiplying constant. Also seen in similar ratio-style formulas like f-stop series.

modes.label: Equals sign or bracket
modes.description: The symbol right after the formula name, before the first constant.

modes.label: Inside constants
modes.description: A digit or decimal point within a constant or exponent in the formula.

modes.label: Age-group constants
modes.description: Digits in age cut-offs beside the K constant values.

card.writes: It favors words about scaling and proportion and disfavors subtraction words, suggesting a multiplying-constant term comes next.
card.plain: It fires inside written kidney-function equations, where a number is multiplied by a fixed constant.
